title: Eternal Winter: Frozen Survival
description: Eternal Winter — hardcore survival modpack where winter never ends. Prepare, adapt, and fight against the cold in a frozen Overworld. Only the strongest will survive.
body:
# **Eternal Winter** 
is a hardcore winter Minecraft modpack made for players who want to truly test their survival skills.

There is no storyline or set path in this pack — just you, the cold, and a brutal frozen world. After spawning, you have limited time to gather resources, prepare yourself, and build a shelter. The frost is your biggest enemy: if you are not ready, you won't last long.

This modpack is fully focused on surviving in the Overworld. The world has been completely reworked around endless winter: new mechanics, atmosphere, world generation, structures, dangers, and survival challenges.


## **Important:**
Eternal Winter is not designed around the Nether or the End.
Those dimensions are mostly untouched and are not part of the main gameplay experience. The real challenge is surviving and progressing in the frozen Overworld.


## **What awaits you:**

a never-ending winter atmosphere;

harsh survival conditions;

the need to think ahead and plan your moves;

improved structures and world exploration;

a revamped combat system;

technology and machinery;

a more immersive experience with enhanced sounds, animations, and visual improvements.


### _This pack is made for players who enjoy:_

hardcore gameplay;

brutal starts;

long survival runs;

building secure bases;

pushing their limits.

### **Minecraft Version:**
Forge 1.19.2

### _Recommended Specs:_
- GPU: RTX 3060 / RTX 4060 or better
- CPU: Intel Core i5 12th–15th gen or similar
- RAM: 8–12 GB allocated
  
This pack is quite heavy due to the large amount of mods, optimization systems, and possible shader usage. For a smooth experience with high settings, stronger hardware is recommended.

_~~Eternal Winter — only those who prepare will survive.~~_
